overview.text: Opire presents bounties for public GitHub issues, connecting open-source projects, developers and supporters. Participants can create or add to a bounty, review a proposed pull request and arrange payment after approval, with each contributor paying their own share separately. This is not a promise of platform escrow or automatic settlement. Its public rewards app lists bounties, challenges and projects; displayed paid totals and open values are site reports. Some priced listings date to 2024, so a displayed reward does not establish a current solvable opening or guaranteed payment.
